title: AI assistant for Slack on Mac: catch up on threads, draft replies and dictate updates
metaTitle: AI assistant for Slack on Mac: ask, reply, dictate
description: Use an AI assistant for Slack on Mac: hold a key to sum up a thread, draft the reply at your cursor, or dictate a standup. Works in the Slack app and in Chrome.
targetKeyword: ai assistant for slack on mac
intro: Lazur is an AI assistant for Slack on your Mac: hold ⌥ ⌘ while a thread is open and ask it to sum up, explain or draft the reply. Hold fn to dictate a message straight into the compose box.
tldr: Hold ⌥ ⌘ in Slack and ask about the thread on screen. Lazur answers out loud.
Say “draft a reply, Thursday works” and the draft lands at your cursor for you to check.
Hold fn to dictate a standup. It comes out as clean lines, not a transcript.
Works in the Slack Mac app and Slack in the browser.

demos.spoken: sum up this thread, what do they need from me?
demos.result: Priya needs the launch date confirmed and the pricing copy by Friday. Nothing else is on you.

demos.spoken: standup, shipped the invite flow, two bugs in the share modal, pairing with Priya after lunch
demos.result: Typed your update at the cursor as three clean lines.
demos.output:
Standup:
• Shipped the invite flow

asks.result: Reads the thread on screen and tells you the decisions and open questions.

asks.say: draft a reply, Thursday works, keep it short
asks.result: Writes the reply at your cursor. You read it and press Enter.

asks.say: where do I schedule a message?
asks.result: Circles the arrow next to the Send button.

asks.say: remind me to answer Sam at 4
asks.result: Adds a reminder to Apple Reminders.

asks.say: what does this error in the channel mean?
asks.result: Explains the pasted log or error message out loud.

asks.say: how do I start a huddle here?
asks.result: Walks you to the huddle button, one click at a time.

blocks.text: Slack is where questions pile up. Lazur sits in the notch above it. Hold ⌥ ⌘, say what you need, and it looks at the Slack window you have open. You do not copy the thread into a chat window first.

items: **Catch up:** “what did I miss in this channel?”
**Reply:** “draft a reply, yes to Thursday, ask about the budget”
**Find your way:** “where's the setting for notifications?”
**Type by voice:** hold fn and talk. The text appears in the compose box.

blocks.text: Dictating Slack messages on a Mac

Click the compose box first. Hold fn, say the update the way you would say it in standup, and let go. Lazur types clean, formatted text at your cursor. Filler words drop out, and lists come out as lists.

blocks.caption: From Slack's keyboard shortcuts help page

faq.question: Does Lazur work in Slack on Mac?
faq.answer: Yes. It works on top of the Slack Mac app and Slack in Chrome or Safari. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask, hold fn to dictate.

faq.question: Is Lazur a Slack app or integration?
faq.answer: No. Nothing is installed in your Slack workspace. Lazur runs on your Mac and only sees the screen while you hold the shortcut.

faq.question: Can Lazur send messages for me?
faq.answer: It writes the draft at your cursor. You read it and press Enter yourself.

faq.question: What does it cost?
faq.answer: Free for 3 days, then Pro is $18/month with 150 AI actions and unlimited dictation.
